Select exact IC50 measurements in nM for compounds tested against human prostaglandin E synthase (CHEMBL5658). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, and docs. Filter by target CHEMBL5658 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
